shots.p: wide shot of an empty primordial landscape of rock and mist under a timeless sky, before mankind existed, nothing to mention
close-up of a newborn baby opening its eyes and turning toward a soft sound, gifts of hearing and sight, warm light
wide shot of a young man at a fork in a desert road at dawn, one path toward a lit mosque, the other into shadow, free choice
wide shot of heavy iron chains and collars lying on dark rocks before a distant roaring blaze, symbolic, no people
close-up of a crystal cup of clear cool drink scented with white camphor blossoms on a marble ledge in a garden, soft light
wide shot of a pure spring gushing from rocks into many little channels flowing through a lush garden wherever they lead
medium shot of a man faithfully fulfilling his vow, carrying a sack of grain to the mosque, looking up at a darkening spreading storm with reverent fear
medium shot of a family sharing their own beloved meal with a poor man, an orphan child and a captive in plain clothes, warm evening
close-up on the humble face of the host serving food, wanting no thanks, sincere and quiet
close-up of the same host at night praying with a worried face, fearing a grim frowning day, dark sky outside
close-up on a radiant joyful face shining with peace and happiness at sunrise
wide shot of a magnificent garden with green silk cushions and canopies by flowing streams on earth, reward of patience
wide shot of shaded couches under trees in a garden, gentle mild light, neither burning sun nor bitter cold
close-up of low branches heavy with ripe fruit hanging within easy reach, deep shade below
close-up of silver vessels and clear glass goblets arranged on a low table in a garden pavilion
macro of goblets made of shimmering silver-like glass, perfectly measured, light glinting through them
close-up of a cup of warm drink with fresh ginger root beside it in a shaded garden, steam curling
wide shot of a smooth gentle spring flowing softly over polished stones in a lush garden, clear water
close-up of shining white pearls scattered across green silk, glowing softly in light
aerial view of a vast endless realm of gardens, palaces and rivers stretching to the horizon, immense kingdom
close-up of folded fine green silk and brocade with silver bracelets resting on it, and a cup of pure water beside them
close-up on the satisfied grateful face of a man in a garden at golden hour, his efforts rewarded
wide shot of soft light descending gently over a quiet valley at dawn, as if a gradual revelation, no figure
medium shot of a man standing patiently against a strong wind, refusing a group of revelers who beckon him to sin
wide shot of a quiet desert at dawn and again at late afternoon, two times of remembrance, peaceful glow
medium shot of a lone worshipper prostrating on a mat in the long silence of the night, starlight through a window
wide shot of crowds rushing after glittering market goods, behind them a heavy dark storm cloud they ignore
close-up on a strong man's firm muscular forearm and joints as he lifts stones, sturdy creation; behind him a new generation of workers arrives
wide shot of a clear path ascending a hill toward a sunrise, open to whoever chooses it
wide shot of a vast starry sky over a sleeping town, wisdom and knowledge, calm and reverent
wide shot of grateful people walking into green shaded gardens on one side, while a dark storm valley lies on the far side
